blocks.py:
# Manacher O(n) longest palindromic substring
t = '^#' + '#'.join(s) + '#$'
p = [0] * len(t)
c = r = 0                            # center, right edge
for i in range(1, len(t)-1):
    mirror = 2*c - i
    if i < r: p[i] = min(r-i, p[mirror])   # mirrored head start
    while t[i+p[i]+1] == t[i-p[i]-1]: p[i] += 1
    if i + p[i] > r: c, r = i, i + p[i]
